app_settings_recording_email.name: app_settings_recording_email
app_settings_recording_email.value: key <> 'recording_email' or (value = lower(trim(value)) and length(value) <= 254 and value like '%_@_%._%')

app_settings_backup_recipients.name: app_settings_backup_recipients
app_settings_backup_recipients.value: key <> 'backup_recipients' or (value = lower(value) and value not glob ('*[ <>"' || char(9, 10, 13, 59) || ']*') and length(value) <= 1274 and value like '%_@_%._%' and value not like ',%' and value not like '%,' and instr(value, ',,') = 0 and length(value) - length(replace(value, ',', '')) <= 4 and length(value) - length(replace(value, '@', '')) = length(value) - length(replace(value, ',', '')) + 1)

assignments_bars_range.name: assignments_bars_range
assignments_bars_range.value: bar_from is null or (bar_from between 1 and 9999 and bar_to between bar_from and 9999)

assignments_description_length.name: assignments_description_length
assignments_description_length.value: description is null or length(trim(description)) between 1 and 1000

attendance_checkin_attended.name: attendance_checkin_attended
attendance_checkin_attended.value: method not in ('qr', 'code') or status in ('present', 'late')

backup_runs_month_check.name: backup_runs_month_check
backup_runs_month_check.value: report_month glob '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-1][0-9]' and substr(report_month, 6, 2) between '01' and '12'

backup_runs_finished.name: backup_runs_finished
backup_runs_finished.value: (status = 'running') = (finished_at is null) and (finished_at is null or finished_at >= started_at)

backup_runs_error.name: backup_runs_error
backup_runs_error.value: (status = 'failed') = (error is not null) and (error is null or length(trim(error)) between 1 and 500)

backup_runs_size.name: backup_runs_size
backup_runs_size.value: size_bytes is null or (typeof(size_bytes) = 'integer' and size_bytes between 0 and 1000000000)

board_ticket_events_body.name: board_ticket_events_body
board_ticket_events_body.value: (kind = 'comment') = (body is not null) and (body is null or (length(trim(body)) >= 1 and length(body) <= 2000))

board_ticket_events_users.name: board_ticket_events_users
board_ticket_events_users.value: kind = 'assignee' or (from_user_id is null and to_user_id is null)

board_ticket_events_values.name: board_ticket_events_values
board_ticket_events_values.value:
coalesce(case kind
        when 'status' then from_value in ('todo', 'in_progress', 'blocked', 'done') and to_value in ('todo', 'in_progress', 'blocked', 'done') and from_value <> to_value
        when 'urgency' then from_value in ('low', 'medium', 'high', 'urgent') and to_value in ('low', 'medium', 'high', 'urgent') and from_value <> to_value
        when 'due' then (from_value is null or date(from_value) is from_value) and (to_value is null or date(to_value) is to_value) and from_value is not to_value
        when 'assignee' then from_value is null and to_value is null and from_user_id is not to_user_id
        else from_value is null and to_value is null end, 0)

board_ticket_reads_seen.name: board_ticket_reads_seen
board_ticket_reads_seen.value: typeof(seen_event_id) = 'integer' and seen_event_id >= 0 and typeof(seen_revision) = 'integer' and seen_revision >= 0

board_tickets_description_length.name: board_tickets_description_length
board_tickets_description_length.value: description is null or length(trim(description)) between 1 and 4000

board_tickets_due_format.name: board_tickets_due_format
board_tickets_due_format.value: due_on is null or (due_on glob '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-1][0-9]-[0-3][0-9]' and date(due_on) is due_on)

budget_revision_lines_amounts.name: budget_revision_lines_amounts
budget_revision_lines_amounts.value: typeof(from_kurus) = 'integer' and typeof(to_kurus) = 'integer' and from_kurus between 0 and 1000000000 and to_kurus between 0 and 1000000000 and from_kurus <> to_kurus

budgets_start_format.name: budgets_start_format
budgets_start_format.value: start_month glob '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-1][0-9]' and strftime('%Y-%m', start_month || '-01') is start_month

budgets_note_length.name: budgets_note_length
budgets_note_length.value: note is null or length(trim(note)) between 1 and 500

dues_overrides_owed.name: dues_overrides_owed
dues_overrides_owed.value: typeof(owed_kurus) = 'integer' and ((kind = 'waiver' and owed_kurus = 0) or (kind = 'freeze' and owed_kurus between 1 and 1000000000))

dues_periods_reduced.name: dues_periods_reduced
dues_periods_reduced.value: reduced_amount_kurus is null or (typeof(reduced_amount_kurus) = 'integer' and reduced_amount_kurus between 1 and amount_kurus - 1)

fe_account.name: fe_account
fe_account.value: account in ('cash', 'bank') and (to_account is null or to_account in ('cash', 'bank'))

fe_transfer.name: fe_transfer
fe_transfer.value: (kind = 'transfer') = (to_account is not null) and (to_account is null or to_account <> account)

fe_dues.name: fe_dues
fe_dues.value: (category is 'dues') = (member_id is not null) and (category is 'dues') = (dues_period_id is not null) and (payment_group_id is null or category is 'dues')

fe_event.name: fe_event
fe_event.value: event_id is null or kind in ('income', 'expense')

fe_texts.name: fe_texts
fe_texts.value: (description is null or length(trim(description)) between 1 and 200) and (counterparty is null or length(trim(counterparty)) between 1 and 120)

fe_document.name: fe_document
fe_document.value: document_url is null or (document_url like 'https://%' and length(document_url) <= 2000)

fe_void_triple.name: fe_void_triple
fe_void_triple.value: (voided_at is null) = (voided_by is null) and (voided_at is null) = (void_reason is null)

fe_void_reason.name: fe_void_reason
fe_void_reason.value: void_reason is null or length(trim(void_reason)) between 5 and 200

fe_replaces_self.name: fe_replaces_self
fe_replaces_self.value: replaces_id is null or replaces_id <> id

import_batches_undo.name: import_batches_undo
import_batches_undo.value: (status = 'undone') = (undone_at is not null) and (undone_at is null) = (undone_by is null) and (undone_at is null or undone_at >= created_at)

import_batches_file_name.name: import_batches_file_name
import_batches_file_name.value: length(trim(file_name)) between 1 and 120 and length(file_name) <= 120 and file_name not glob ('*[' || char(1, 9, 10, 13, 47, 92) || ']*')

import_batches_counts.name: import_batches_counts
import_batches_counts.value: typeof(row_count) = 'integer' and typeof(added_count) = 'integer' and typeof(updated_count) = 'integer' and typeof(unchanged_count) = 'integer' and row_count between 1 and 5000 and added_count >= 0 and updated_count >= 0 and unchanged_count >= 0 and added_count + updated_count + unchanged_count = row_count and added_count + updated_count >= 1

import_items_one_target.name: import_items_one_target
import_items_one_target.value: coalesce(case target when 'user' then term_id is null and rehearsal_id is null and finance_entry_id is null and dues_period_id is null and override_period_id is null and sponsor_id is null and user_id is not null when 'term' then user_id is null and rehearsal_id is null and finance_entry_id is null and dues_period_id is null and override_period_id is null and sponsor_id is null when 'rehearsal' then user_id is null and term_id is null and finance_entry_id is null and dues_period_id is null and override_period_id is null and sponsor_id is null when 'finance_entry' then user_id is null and term_id is null and rehearsal_id is null and dues_period_id is null and override_period_id is null and sponsor_id is null and finance_entry_id is not null when 'dues_period' then user_id is null and term_id is null and rehearsal_id is null and finance_entry_id is null and override_period_id is null and sponsor_id is null when 'dues_override' then user_id is null and term_id is null and rehearsal_id is null and finance_entry_id is null and dues_period_id is null and sponsor_id is null when 'sponsor' then user_id is null and term_id is null and rehearsal_id is null and finance_entry_id is null and dues_period_id is null and override_period_id is null and sponsor_id is not null end, 0)

import_items_kayit.name: import_items_kayit
import_items_kayit.value: (kayit_no is null) = (kayit_scope is null) and (kayit_scope is null or kayit_scope in ('entries', 'dues_payments')) and (kayit_no is null or (length(kayit_no) between 1 and 40 and kayit_no not glob '*[^A-Za-z0-9._/-]*')) and (kayit_no is null or target in ('finance_entry', 'dues_override')) and (target <> 'finance_entry' or kayit_no is not null)

import_items_json.name: import_items_json
import_items_json.value: (action = 'update') = (before_json is not null) and (before_json is null or (json_valid(before_json) and length(before_json) <= 4000)) and (after_json is null or (json_valid(after_json) and length(after_json) <= 4000)) and (target not in ('user', 'rehearsal', 'dues_period', 'dues_override', 'sponsor') or after_json is not null)

member_dues_note_length.name: member_dues_note_length
member_dues_note_length.value: note is null or length(trim(note)) between 1 and 200

midi_files_voice_part_check.name: midi_files_voice_part_check
midi_files_voice_part_check.value: voice_part is null or voice_part in ('soprano', 'alto', 'tenor', 'bass')

midi_files_label_length.name: midi_files_label_length
midi_files_label_length.value: label is null or (length(trim(label)) between 1 and 60 and length(label) <= 60)

midi_files_storage_key_check.name: midi_files_storage_key_check
midi_files_storage_key_check.value: substr(storage_key, 1, 5) = 'midi/' and length(substr(storage_key, 6, 36)) = 36 and substr(storage_key, 6, 36) not glob '*[^0-9a-f-]*' and substr(storage_key, 42) = '.mid'

notifications_group_check.name: notifications_group_check
notifications_group_check.value: group_key is null or group_key in ('calisma', 'devamsizlik', 'odev', 'dinleme', 'repertuvar', 'yonetim', 'aidat', 'butce', 'sistem', 'gece')

notifications_lengths.name: notifications_lengths
notifications_lengths.value: length(title) between 1 and 40 and length(body) between 1 and 400 and length(tag) between 1 and 64 and length(dedupe_key) <= 200

piece_links_voice_part_check.name: piece_links_voice_part_check
piece_links_voice_part_check.value: voice_part is null or voice_part in ('soprano', 'alto', 'tenor', 'bass')

piece_links_label_length.name: piece_links_label_length
piece_links_label_length.value: label is null or length(trim(label)) between 1 and 120

pieces_composer_length.name: pieces_composer_length
pieces_composer_length.value: composer is null or length(composer) between 1 and 120

pieces_arranger_length.name: pieces_arranger_length
pieces_arranger_length.value: arranger is null or length(arranger) between 1 and 120

pieces_language_length.name: pieces_language_length
pieces_language_length.value: language is null or length(language) between 1 and 40

pieces_voicing_length.name: pieces_voicing_length
pieces_voicing_length.value: voicing is null or length(voicing) between 1 and 20

pieces_duration_range.name: pieces_duration_range
pieces_duration_range.value: duration_sec is null or duration_sec between 1 and 5999

pieces_notes_length.name: pieces_notes_length
pieces_notes_length.value: notes is null or length(notes) between 1 and 1000

pieces_folder_url_check.name: pieces_folder_url_check
pieces_folder_url_check.value: drive_folder_url is null or (substr(drive_folder_url, 1, 8) = 'https://' and length(drive_folder_url) <= 2000)

push_subscriptions_fail_check.name: push_subscriptions_fail_check
push_subscriptions_fail_check.value: typeof(fail_count) = 'integer' and fail_count >= 0 and (fail_count = 0) = (first_fail_at is null)

recordings_commented_idx.name: recordings_commented_idx
recordings_commented_idx.where: audio_deleted_at is null and commented_at is not null

recordings_storage_key_check.name: recordings_storage_key_check
recordings_storage_key_check.value: substr(storage_key, 1, 11) = 'recordings/' and length(substr(storage_key, 12, 36)) = 36 and substr(storage_key, 12, 36) not glob '*[^0-9a-f-]*' and substr(storage_key, 48) = '.' || case content_type when 'audio/mp4' then 'm4a' when 'audio/mpeg' then 'mp3' when 'audio/aac' then 'aac' when 'audio/webm' then 'webm' when 'audio/ogg' then 'ogg' when 'audio/wav' then 'wav' end

recordings_duration_check.name: recordings_duration_check
recordings_duration_check.value: duration_ms is null or (typeof(duration_ms) = 'integer' and duration_ms between 0 and 600000)

recordings_replaces_self.name: recordings_replaces_self
recordings_replaces_self.value: replaces_id is null or replaces_id <> id

recordings_replaced.name: recordings_replaced
recordings_replaced.value: replaced_at is null or (replaced_at >= uploaded_at and audio_deleted_at is not null and commented_at is null)

recordings_commented.name: recordings_commented
recordings_commented.value: commented_at is null or commented_at >= uploaded_at

recordings_delete_on.name: recordings_delete_on
recordings_delete_on.value: delete_on glob '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-1][0-9]-[0-3][0-9]' and date(delete_on) is delete_on and delete_on > date(uploaded_at, 'unixepoch')

recordings_deleted.name: recordings_deleted
recordings_deleted.value: (audio_deleted_at is null) = (deleted_reason is null) and (deleted_reason is null or deleted_reason in ('replaced', 'withdrawn', 'conductor', 'retention', 'early', 'missing')) and (audio_deleted_at is null or audio_deleted_at >= uploaded_at)

rehearsals_open_idx.name: rehearsals_open_idx
rehearsals_open_idx.where: opened_at is not null and closed_at is null

rehearsals_closed_after_open.name: rehearsals_closed_after_open
rehearsals_closed_after_open.value: closed_at is null or (opened_at is not null and closed_at >= opened_at)

rehearsals_cancelled_not_open.name: rehearsals_cancelled_not_open
rehearsals_cancelled_not_open.value: cancelled_at is null or opened_at is null

sponsors_texts.name: sponsors_texts
sponsors_texts.value: (contact_name is null or length(trim(contact_name)) between 1 and 80) and (contact is null or length(trim(contact)) between 1 and 120) and (note is null or length(trim(note)) between 1 and 500)

storage_deletions_key_check.name: storage_deletions_key_check
storage_deletions_key_check.value: (area = 'recording' and substr(storage_key, 1, 11) = 'recordings/' and length(substr(storage_key, 12, 36)) = 36 and substr(storage_key, 12, 36) not glob '*[^0-9a-f-]*' and substr(storage_key, 48) in ('.m4a', '.mp3', '.aac', '.webm', '.ogg', '.wav')) or (area = 'midi' and substr(storage_key, 1, 5) = 'midi/' and length(substr(storage_key, 6, 36)) = 36 and substr(storage_key, 6, 36) not glob '*[^0-9a-f-]*' and substr(storage_key, 42) = '.mid')

storage_deletions_attempts.name: storage_deletions_attempts
storage_deletions_attempts.value: typeof(attempts) = 'integer' and attempts >= 0 and (attempts = 0) = (last_attempt_at is null) and (last_error is null or (last_error in ('unavailable', 'suspended', 'rate_limited', 'auth', 'fault', 'unknown') and attempts >= 1))

storage_sweeps_counts.name: storage_sweeps_counts
storage_sweeps_counts.value: typeof(expired) = 'integer' and typeof(deleted) = 'integer' and typeof(failed) = 'integer' and expired >= 0 and deleted >= 0 and failed >= 0

submissions_method_check.name: submissions_method_check
submissions_method_check.value: method is null or method in ('self', 'manual')

submissions_feedback_meta.name: submissions_feedback_meta
submissions_feedback_meta.value: feedback is not null or (feedback_by is null and feedback_seen_at is null)

submissions_feedback_length.name: submissions_feedback_length
submissions_feedback_length.value: feedback is null or length(trim(feedback)) between 1 and 1000

submissions_not_empty.name: submissions_not_empty
submissions_not_empty.value: submitted_at is not null or feedback is not null

users_voice_part_check.name: users_voice_part_check
users_voice_part_check.value: voice_part is null or voice_part in ('soprano', 'alto', 'tenor', 'bass')

users_left_after_joined.name: users_left_after_joined
users_left_after_joined.value: left_at is null or left_at >= joined_at
